description.value: Mission Springs Brewing Company is one of BC's oldest craft brewhouses, opened in 1996 and operating a 10-barrel facility overlooking the Fraser River in Mission. The brewpub pairs its house-crafted beers — available on tap, in growlers, cans, and bottles — with a full pub menu served across three patios and a dining room. It is part of the Springs Group, which also runs an attached liquor store where cyclists can pick up beer to go.
